newsitem.title: GERMANY: DMG, CS First Boston to manage Romanian Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: DMG, CS First Boston to manage Romanian Eurobond.

text.p: Deutsche Morgan Grenfell and CS First Boston have jointly received a mandate to act as bookrunners and lead managers for Romania's first mark-denominated bond issue, Deutsche Bank AG said on Thursday.
Romania has a Ba3 rating from Moody's and a BB- rating from Standard & Poors, Deutsche added.
Representatives of the Romanian finance ministry plan to go on a road show before the issue to several different financial centres. No further details of the deal were available at the moment.
